subject: CAIQ surface mapping + delegated uploader for Vendr onboarding
messages:
From: Julie Santos <julie.santos@aeterna.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ surface mapping + delegated uploader for Vendr onboarding

Hi Rishi / team,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We're starting the security intake for Vendr and have two actionable asks to keep the onboarding window next week:

1) CAIQ mapping: Aeterna's compliance team needs a mapping table that ties your CAIQ answers to our control IDs (we've attached our spreadsheet template). Can you confirm which CAIQ sections are covered by the Vendr profile and send back a filled mapping?

2) Upload / evidence handoff: For bulk evidence we'll need a delegated uploader flow (presigned S3 approach preferred) and proof that the manifest is signed by your KMS (or an HSM-backed signature). Our procurement team requires a signed manifest and a short attestation that the uploaded artifacts are the same files referenced in CAIQ.

If it's easier, provide a short mutual action plan and an ETA for the two asks. We're happy to open a DocuSign attestation if Redwood prefers a signature flow.

Attachments: aeterna_caiq_template.xlsx (their template), onboarding-sla.pdf

Julie Santos
Security Programs Lead | Aeterna Health
julie.santos@aeterna.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Julie Santos <julie.santos@aeterna.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ surface mapping + delegated uploader for Vendr onboarding

Julie — thanks, and good to hear. See plan below; attaching our initial CAIQ-to-Aeterna mapping (caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx) and a small Vendr profile snapshot to accelerate triage.

Proposed action items (short):
- I will validate the CAIQ mapping against Vendr's profile and return a filled sheet by EOD tomorrow (Jul 30).
- Ben will own the presign/upload choreography and produce the presign window and S3 manifest procedure by Friday.
- Laura will coordinate the KMS evidence: we can provide a signed manifest (kms_keyproof.txt) showing signing key thumbprint and timestamp; Laura will confirm whether an HSM statement is required.
- If you need a DocuSign attestation, indicate the addressee and I'll route to legal.

Notes / constraints:
- Vendr's current profile includes a transient service account for uploads; presign buckets are in us-west-2 and retention TTL is 30 days by default. If you need longer retention please state it and we'll set a bespoke TTL for the upload window.

Attachments: caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (Redwood mapping), vendr_profile_snapshot.json

Thanks — I'll loop back once Ben confirms the presign steps.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Julie Santos <julie.santos@aeterna.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -0700

On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 10:04 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Julie — thanks, and good to hear. See plan below; attaching our initial CAIQ-to-Aeterna mapping (caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx) and a small Vendr profile snapshot to accelerate triage.

I'll take the KMS evidence deliverable. Quick clarifications for internal tracking:
- We will provide a signed manifest that includes key fingerprint, signing timestamp, and an audit reference (manifest_id). The signed blob will be a small ASCII file (kms_keyproof.txt) referencing the presign window.
- Ben — pls confirm the presign SKU: will we use ephemeral presign tokens for a 48-hour window or a longer window? Also confirm whether uploads will be performed by an Aeterna service account or via a temporary delegated uploader we create for this engagement.

Julie — if Aeterna prefers us to create a delegated uploader, we will need the uploader principal email and a short IP allowlist for the upload window. Otherwise, presign-by-client is fine.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Julie Santos <julie.santos@aeterna.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ surface mapping + delegated uploader for Vendr onboarding

On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 1:22 PM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — pls confirm the presign SKU: will we use ephemeral presign tokens for a 48-hour window or a longer window? Also confirm whether uploads will be performed by an Aeterna service account or via a temporary delegated uploader we create for this engagement.

Hi team — quick update and checklist so Julie can confirm.

What we'll provide:
- Presign approach: we can offer two modes. (A) Client-generated presigns: Aeterna signs the upload URLs on your side using a short-lived token we issue (recommended 48–72 hours). (B) Redwood delegated uploader: we create a temporary service account (redwood-vendr-uploader@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com) scoped to a single bucket/prefix; uploads are performed by our agent and we hand back a signed manifest.
- Default presign window: 48 hours. If you need 7 days, we can extend but will require a retention SLA exception and alternate encryption policy.
- KMS evidence: attached kms_keyproof.txt is the signed manifest stub (base64 signature + key thumbprint + timestamp). We'll also include vendr_profile_snapshot.json showing the profile version used to produce the mapping.

Action for Aeterna: please confirm 1) preferred upload mode (client presign vs. Redwood delegated uploader), 2) desired presign window (48h default), and 3) whether you require DocuSign attestation (if so, provide sig recipient). Once confirmed I'll schedule the presign window and push the signed manifest to the Drive link above.

Attachments (stubs): kms_keyproof.txt, vendr_profile_snapshot.json

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Platform Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
